description: Defines the ISensorHalWrapper interface and related classes for sensor HAL abstraction in Android, including callback mechanisms, connection status, and sensor control methods.

classes.name: ISensorHalWrapper
classes.description: Interface for sensor HAL wrapper, providing methods for connecting, polling, and controlling sensors.

classes.name: SensorDeviceCallback
classes.description: Callback interface for sensor device connection and disconnection events.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the sensors HAL, used for initial connection and reconnections.

methods.name: prepareForReconnect
methods.description: Prepares the wrapper for a reconnection attempt.

methods.name: supportsMessageQueues
methods.description: Checks if message queues are supported.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Polls for sensor events using traditional sensors or FMQ.

methods.name: pollFmq
methods.description: Polls for sensor events from a FMQ.

methods.name: getSensorsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available sensors.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the operation mode of the sensor HAL.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific sensor.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Configures batching parameters for a sensor.

methods.name: injectSensorData
methods.description: Injects sensor data into the HAL.

methods.name: registerDirectChannel
methods.description: Registers a direct memory channel for sensor data.
